purpose: QC7-5244 black clean-surface material and texture profile based on normal real images. This profile separates the base plastic appearance into matte fine-grain plastic, ribbed border plastic, and smoother semi-gloss structural plastic.

reference_images.actual_local_folder: E:/BlenderProject/BlenderProc/塑料工件真实数据集/QC7-5244黑色/QC9-0852-正常
visual_observations: The main broad panel is a dark cool-gray/black molded plastic with very fine matte grain.
The raised tray and large flat panel show broad soft highlights, not glossy mirror highlights.
The left/top/bottom border bands contain dense regular ribbed or grid-like texture, darker than the main panel.
Rounded recesses, latches, and small molded structures are smoother and more semi-gloss than the main matte panel.
Texture should belong to the clean material profile and should not be emitted as defect masks.

renderer_compatibility.note: This file is complete as the v1 profile spec. The single global material_parameters block is immediately compatible with the current generic backend. Region-specific procedural texture layers require later shader/region assignment support.

main_fine_matte_plastic.role: default broad panel, inset tray, large smooth defect-capable areas

ribbed_border_plastic.role: left vertical band plus top and bottom textured border bands

semi_gloss_structural_plastic.role: rounded recesses, circular gate area, latches, hooks, and small molded structures

deep_shadow_inner_parts.role: deep cavities and occluded inner walls

notes: If the STL exposes separate objects or material slots for border bands, assign ribbed_border_plastic there first.
If the STL is a single mesh, use coordinate windows for the border bands and normal-facing main planes for the main matte material.
Rounded recesses and small molded structures can initially remain on the global material until mesh-region assignment is implemented.

acceptance_checks: Main panel should read as dark cool-gray black, not pure black.
Main panel should show fine matte grain without obvious large noise blobs.
Border bands should show regular ribbed/grid texture and be slightly darker than the main panel.
Rounded recess and molded features should keep clearer highlights than the main panel.
Clean texture must not be included in defect masks or labels.

next_integration_step.safe_option_without_touching_other_files: Use material_parameters as a drop-in manual material candidate when invoking a renderer that accepts an explicit material profile path.
next_integration_step.full_option_requires_code_changes: Teach render_generic_main_plane_defects.py to consume surface_regions and assign procedural materials by object/material slot or normalized coordinate windows.
